name: Oslo Three-Seat Sofa
description: Low-arm three-seat sofa on a kiln-dried oak base with feather-blend seat cushions. The oatmeal linen stays visually light in a modest living room.

name: Fjord Low Sofa
description: Deep seat and a low back in oatmeal wool boucle so the sofa can sit under a window without blocking the view. Rounded arms and short oak legs.

name: Haven L-Sectional
description: Left-chaise sectional in sand performance fabric with loose back cushions. The 280 cm run needs the longer wall.

name: Midmod Tweed Sofa
description: Tapered walnut legs, track arms, and charcoal tweed upholstery in a late-1950s three-seat silhouette. Firm seat, no button tufting.

name: Walnut Leather Sofa
description: Cognac top-grain leather on a walnut frame with one long seat cushion. Wipes clean and darkens slightly with use.

name: Loft Chesterfield Sofa
description: Deep-buttoned tobacco leather with a stained oak plinth instead of turned feet. Heavy and formal, suited to a brick-wall loft.

name: Indigo Velvet Sofa
description: Inky blue cotton velvet, a tight back, and slim black metal legs. One saturated piece against otherwise neutral walls.

name: Coastal Slipcover Sofa
description: Relaxed three-seat with a machine-washable white cotton slipcover and a slightly slumped seat. Meant for a sunny window wall.

name: Rustic Oak Frame Sofa
description: Exposed oak arms and a loose oatmeal linen cushion set. The frame carries the look, so it does not need a pile of pillows.

name: Japandi Daybed Sofa
description: Low armless daybed on a light ash platform with a single long bolster. Seating by day and a guest bed with a throw.

name: Compact Boucle Loveseat
description: Two-seat loveseat in cream boucle with short oak legs. Sized for rooms where a full sofa would crowd the coffee table.

name: Cloud Modular Sofa
description: Three deep modules in cloud boucle on a recessed plinth. The lowest back in the catalog, for open plans where the sofa should not block a view.

name: Bergen Lounge Chair
description: Curved oak shell with a loose light-gray wool seat pad. Sits well alone beside a window or paired across from a sofa.

name: Shell Lounge Chair
description: Molded walnut plywood shell, black leather cushion, and a wire swivel base. The familiar mid-century lounge silhouette.

name: Accent Boucle Chair
description: Rounded accent chair in ivory boucle with a fully upholstered base. Soft enough for reading, structured enough to face a sofa.

name: Pipe Armchair
description: Black pipe frame with saddle-leather straps for the seat and back. Light enough to pull up to a coffee table.

name: Linen Wingback Chair
description: Tall wingback in stone linen with dark tapered legs. The high back blocks a draft from a nearby doorway.

name: Papasan Chair
description: Round rattan bowl on a matching stand with a thick natural cotton cushion. Wide stance, so it belongs in a corner rather than a narrow aisle.

name: Low Floor Chair
description: Low oak frame and a thin linen cushion for seating close to a low coffee table. Also works as extra seating when guests sit on the floor.

name: Swivel Velvet Chair
description: Moss-green velvet chair on a low disk swivel. Turns toward conversation or the window without reading as an office chair.

name: Oak Rocker
description: Steam-bent oak runners and a charcoal woven-wool seat. Needs clear floor behind the runners.

name: Slipper Chair
description: Armless slipper chair in pale blue cotton with a tight seat. Small enough to tuck beside a sofa as a third seat.

name: Club Leather Chair
description: Low club chair in black leather with a wide track arm and a solid wood plinth. Visually heavy; one is enough in a small room.

name: Cane Side Chair
description: Oak side chair with a cane back, meant as pull-up seating rather than a lounge chair. Light enough to move when the room is rearranged.

name: Oval Oak Coffee Table
description: Solid white-oak oval with softened edges and a lower shelf for books. The oval keeps walkways clear around a sofa.

name: Marble Slab Coffee Table
description: Honed white marble top on a thin blackened-steel frame. Heavy, cool, and easy to style with a single tray.

name: Round Walnut Coffee Table
description: A 100 cm walnut circle with tapered legs and a small drawer. Round tops suit sectionals and conversation seating.

name: Crate Coffee Table
description: Reclaimed pine planks on a black steel crate base with an open lower shelf. The finish is intentionally uneven.

name: Travertine Coffee Table
description: Low rectangular block of unfilled travertine with no legs, so the visual weight stays on the floor.

name: Nesting Oak Coffee Tables
description: Two oak nesting tables that slide together when the room needs floor space. The smaller one can stand in as a side surface.

name: Glass Top Coffee Table
description: Clear tempered glass on a chrome sled base. Visually light in a tight room so the rug stays visible.

name: Live Edge Coffee Table
description: Single walnut slab with a natural edge and a black steel U-base. Width is measured at the longest point.

name: Low Ash Coffee Table
description: Very low ash table with a lifted lip, sized for floor seating and low sofas. A tray stores underneath.

name: Drum Coffee Table
description: Carved mango-wood drum used as a small coffee table. Better in front of a loveseat than a full three-seat sofa.

name: Round Oak Side Table
description: Three-leg white-oak side table at sofa-arm height. Stable enough for a lamp and a glass.

name: Marble Pedestal Side Table
description: Small honed-marble disk on a solid pedestal. Tight footprint beside a lounge chair.

name: C-Shaped Side Table
description: Slim black steel C-table that slides over a sofa seat. Useful when the arm is too narrow for a drink.

name: Pipe Side Table
description: Black pipe frame with a round pine top. Pairs with the pipe armchair without looking like a matched set.

name: Walnut Drawer Side Table
description: One drawer, tapered legs, and a walnut top large enough for a table lamp. Sits at the end of a sofa.

name: Ceramic Drum Side Table
description: Hand-glazed ceramic garden stool used as a side table. Cream glaze with a dark rim.

name: Nesting Metal Side Tables
description: A pair of powder-coated steel cubes, one slightly smaller. Pull the small one out when guests need a surface.

name: Rattan Side Table
description: Open-weave rattan cylinder with a glass insert on top. Light, inexpensive, and easy to move.

name: Brass Arc Floor Lamp
description: Brass arc on a marble base with about 160 cm of reach over a sofa. Park the base behind the sofa so the shade lands over the seat. Listed dimensions are the base footprint and overall height.

name: Tripod Floor Lamp
description: Three oak legs and a linen drum shade. The tripod footprint is wider than a pole lamp, so keep it out of the main path.

name: Industrial Floor Lamp
description: Black steel pharmacy lamp with an adjustable arm and a metal shade. Task light for a reading chair.

name: Paper Lantern Floor Lamp
description: Tall rice-paper column on a small wood base. Soft ambient light rather than a reading lamp.

name: Ceramic Table Lamp
description: Matte sand ceramic base with a tapered linen shade. Sized for the round oak side table.

name: Brass Task Lamp
description: Small adjustable brass lamp with a conical shade. Sits on a side table and points at a book.

name: Globe Pendant
description: 32 cm opal glass globe on a short brass canopy. Hung over a coffee table it becomes the room center light. Dimensions are the fixture, not the drop.

name: Rattan Pendant
description: Open rattan dome that throws a patterned shadow. Best centered over a table rather than tucked in a low corner.

name: Matte Black Arc Lamp
description: Matte black arc with about 150 cm of reach and a flat steel base instead of marble. Dimensions are the base footprint and overall height.

name: Alabaster Table Lamp
description: Glowing alabaster cube with no fabric shade. Low warm light beside a wingback or on a drawer side table.

name: Wool Flatweave Rug
description: Undyed cream wool flatweave with two thin charcoal stripes. Low pile so chair legs slide, and large enough for the front sofa legs.

name: Natural Jute Rug
description: Braided jute with a cotton binding. Texture-first, and better under a coffee table than under a rolling chair.

name: Moroccan Shag Rug
description: High-pile ivory wool shag with a faint diamond. Hides wear and needs a vacuum with a beater bar.

name: Persian-Style Rug
description: Densely patterned wool rug in rust, indigo, and cream. The 240 by 340 cm size anchors a full seating group.

name: Abstract Modern Rug
description: Soft-edged blocks of sand, clay, and black on a low pile. Sits under a marble coffee table without fighting it.

name: Kilim Rug
description: Flat kilim with geometric bands in rust and black. Thin enough that a door can swing over the edge.

name: Hide Rug
description: Natural hide pieced from two skins with a short hair direction. The outline is irregular; listed size is the bounding box.

name: Low-Pile Gray Rug
description: Heather-gray low pile that is easy to clean. The practical, lower-priced option under a family sofa.
